# Test reference

`pybrinson` is included here **only** for numerical comparison tests. It is
not imported by `brinsons` at runtime and is not installed with the package.

Source: [gghez/pybrinson](https://github.com/gghez/pybrinson), commit
`529b0940937caacec3f2a30609b9ce6b86316a7b`. Its MIT license is preserved
at [`pybrinson/LICENSE`](pybrinson/LICENSE).
